1. (Currently amended) A composition comprising a compound of formula I:

[formula structure]

wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9 and R10 are independently selected from hydrogen, halogen, alkyl, alkoxy, hydroxyl, amino, nitro, cyano, carboxyl, alkoxycarbonyl, carbamoyl, alkylcarbamoyl, dialkylcarbamoyl, aryl, heteroaryl, cycloalkyl, heterocycloalkyl, alkenyl, alkynyl, arylalkyl, heteroarylalkyl, cycloalkylalkyl, heterocycloalkylalkyl, alkenylalkyl, alkynylalkyl, and physiologically acceptable salts thereof, __for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, __wherein the composition is formulated for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0,00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight, __and wherein the composition is for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

5. (Currently amended) Composition according to claim 1, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine __in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight__, __wherein the composition is for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, __specifically__ for the treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, for the treatment of other defects of keratinisation, __specifically__ ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), for the treatment of other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component, and __specifically__ all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development __in the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

10. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair __in the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening __in the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

13. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the [[prophylaxis against or]] reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin, __wherein the skin unevenness is associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

14. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for [[the prophylaxis against]] __the treatment of__ time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair __that are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__, __specifically__ for [[prophylaxis against]] __treatment of__ dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction [[or prevention]] of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin.
